subject: Product trajectories + release contingency sync
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Rivera <ava@acmelogistics.com>, Taylor Kim <taylor@acmelogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Product trajectories + release contingency sync

Team —

Per prep for next week’s QBR, I pulled the latest trajectory doc and dependency heatmap (attached). High-level summary:

- Beta (partner pilot): target June 15 — currently GREEN for product scope, YELLOW for infra readiness.
- GA (public): target Aug 1 — YELLOW overall (main risks below).
- Integrations wave (marketplace + connectors): target Sep 15 — RED on third-party adapter work.

Top delivery risks I want on the table now (impact x likelihood):
1) Quantization regression on long-contexts (HIGH x MEDIUM) — our internal accuracy checks show a 4–7% BLEU-like drop on longer prompts with current 4-bit profile.
2) Tokenizer incompatibility (MEDIUM x HIGH) — Acme's custom token set exposes a bug in upstream tokenizer v2.1; engineering has a patch in progress but it blocks canary parity tests.
3) Autoscaling and warm-start for Dedicated pools (HIGH x MEDIUM) — we need a burst policy to avoid tail latency spikes at GA volumes.
4) Compliance evidence for Private (audit) — legal requested retention-envelope details by May 28.

Asks:
- Vivek: confirm ownership for quantization parity runs and a target for a mitigation build by 05/24.
- Lauren: confirm whether we can accept a one-week sliding window on the Beta target if needed (decision by 05/25).
- Marcus: lead the contingency decision (fallback model + routing policy) and present a short runbook by 05/26.

I’ve attached the trajectory deck, the proposed contingency playbook, and the dependency heatmap. Please reply with short ownership lines and any blockers you foresee. I’ll consolidate for the exec readout.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-05-20_roadmap_trajectory_v3.pdf (pdf), contingency_playbook_v2.md (md), dependency_heatmap_20260520.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Rivera <ava@acmelogistics.com>, Taylor Kim <taylor@acmelogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Product trajectories + release contingency sync

Jasmine —

Acknowledged. Quick notes from infra/eng:

1) Quantization: the regression looks tied to the new kernel path for KV cache sharding. We have a branch that reduces the drop to ~2% but increases peak memory for short sequences. I can push a mitigation build by EOD 05/24 if we greenlight the memory tradeoff for Beta canaries.

2) Tokenizer: the external tokenizer v2.1 bug is real — our patch is ready but needs integration testing with Acme corp tokens. We need Taylor to drop a representative file for automated tests.

3) Autoscaling: we can implement a burst reservation policy for Dedicated pools and a 72-hour extended canary window to surface tail issues. Cost estimate attached (approx +12% infra runrate during canary window).

Proposed immediate actions:
- Approve mitigation build memory tradeoff for Beta canary (decision by 05/24).
- Taylor/Ava: send token sample by 05/21 so integration tests run this week.
- Marcus: if you accept the +12% runrate for canary, infra will enable burst reservations for Beta region.

On the tokenizer point —

Vivek

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Product trajectories + release contingency sync

Jasmine — thanks for the summary. A few product-level clarifications:

- Beta scope: we should freeze non-critical UX tweaks; any remaining polish should be deferred to post-Beta.
- Timeline flexibility: I can accept a one-week Beta slide to June 22 if it materially reduces risk on quantization and tokenizer parity. We need to communicate that to Acme asap so they can adjust pilot onboarding.
- Metrics gating: propose the following pass/fail for Beta canary: 95th token latency target met, model parity within 3% on our eval suite, and zero critical security regressions.

Action items for product: I will prepare a short communication for Acme (3 bullets) once we decide on the slide. Need decision by 05/25 to finalize pilot plan and invitations.

—Lauren
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

- Vivek: proceed with mitigation build candidate and cost estimate; lane owner set to you (target 05/24).
- Lauren: we’ll target a one-week slide for Beta (decision window remains 05/25).
- Marcus: please produce the short contingency runbook by 05/26 and confirm burst policy cost acceptance.

I’ll draft the Acme note if we confirm a slide; want to keep external comms crisp (two bullets + a single ask).

Jasmine

Team — finalizing owners and timeline for the exec packet:

1) Quantization mitigation build — owner: Vivek. Target: 2026-05-24 EOD. Contingency: roll to 3-bit profile + stricter eval if parity not met.
2) Tokenizer integration — owner: Taylor (Acme), eng contact: Vivek. Target: token samples by 2026-05-21; full automated run by 2026-05-23.
3) Beta slide decision — owner: Lauren. Decision deadline: 2026-05-25. If slide accepted, update external pilot invite and kickoff cadence.
4) Burst reservations for Dedicated pools — owner: Marcus (infra budget approval). Decision point: 2026-05-26 with approval of +12% canary runrate.
5) Compliance evidence for Private — owner: Legal (Acme copy) + Product (Lauren). Package due: 2026-05-28.

I’ll assemble the one-page contingency section for the QBR packet and circulate a draft by 2026-05-26 12:00 PDT. If anyone needs different owners or times, flag now.

—Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference
